in_sanskrit.name: रूपली
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is filled with beauty or the one who is full of form. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root word रूप (rūp) meaning form or appearance.

in_hindi.name: रूपाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one whose form is beloved or the one who is loved for her form.

in_marathi.name: Rupali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Waves of the Sea
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupa means form or wealth. Ali means waves. The name Rupali means 'waves of form or wealth'.

in_bengali.name: Rupali
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Waves of the Sea
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rupali একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rupa means form or wealth. Ali means waves. The name Rupali means 'waves of form or wealth'.
